title: Pyrefly End-State Board
heading: End-State Board
lede: Every picture here is a target for the finished game. Approved means you said yes and it is on record. Needs your verdict means a picture exists and nobody has your yes or no written down. No target yet means there is nothing to look at, so that area gets an options round before anyone builds it.
foot: Built from docs/target/targets.json by node tools/end-state-board.mjs. When you approve or reject something, the session you are talking to records it in that file with your words and the date, then reruns the script. Pictures are shrunk copies; the originals are in docs/screenshots and public/art.

tiles.label: Onboarding C1: Auron’s briefing
tiles.approved: Bailey, 20 Sep 2026, picked in the orchestrator's AskUserQuestion: “C: Auron’s briefing” — “Twenty skippable seconds in the game’s own voice (Auron’s painting, four lines framing both clocks), then one whispered line the first time something is real; FFX-2 lines come from Rikku with nothing paused; replayable from pause.”
tiles.build: The first screen after the title on a first launch: the approved Auron painting on the left, four lines in his voice framing both clocks, a visible twenty-second timer, and skip / never-show-again on the same line. Skippable from frame one by key, mouse, touch and pad. Replayable from the title and from pause.
tiles.note: Both games: this is the one shared surface, and it is where the two clocks are named once. Options A (taught first turn) and B (field notes) were not picked.

tiles.label: Onboarding C2: FFX first-use line (Auron)
tiles.approved: Bailey, 20 Sep 2026, picked in the orchestrator's AskUserQuestion: “C: Auron’s briefing” — “Twenty skippable seconds in the game’s own voice (Auron’s painting, four lines framing both clocks), then one whispered line the first time something is real; FFX-2 lines come from Rikku with nothing paused; replayable from pause.”
tiles.build: Chapter 1-3, the first time turn order is real: one italic line in Auron’s voice beside the command menu, ENTER CONTINUE, FIRST TIME ONLY. No dim, no numbered course, no second surface.
tiles.note: FFX only (research/ffx-vs-ffx2-presentation.md §9 row 3: the turn-order preview is true for FFX and not for FFX-2). FFX is turn-based, so the line may hold the decision until one confirm press — the engine is already waiting for input and no clock runs.

tiles.label: Onboarding C3: FFX-2 first-use line (Rikku) and the pause rows
tiles.approved: Bailey, 20 Sep 2026, picked in the orchestrator's AskUserQuestion: “C: Auron’s briefing” — “Twenty skippable seconds in the game’s own voice (Auron’s painting, four lines framing both clocks), then one whispered line the first time something is real; FFX-2 lines come from Rikku with nothing paused; replayable from pause.”
tiles.build: Chapter 4-5, the first time a gauge fills: one line in Rikku’s voice beside the party rows that fades on its own with KEEP PLAYING · NOTHING TO PRESS, plus the two pause rows — REPLAY BRIEFING and BATTLE HELP ON / OFF.
tiles.note: FFX-2 only for the voice and the non-blocking behaviour (§4.2 / FC-4 and §4.3 / FC-5: the gauge is a four-phase pipeline and its charge segment is canon’s own cost preview; teaching may never freeze it). BATTLE HELP is a real FFX-2 Config entry (research/ffx-vs-ffx2-presentation.md:278), so the toggle is labelled exactly as the game labels it. Replay and the toggle are both games. ONE KNOWING DEPARTURE FROM THE FRAME’S LABEL, 20 Sep 2026: the mockup’s badge reads NOTHING PAUSED · GAUGES RUNNING, and an adversarial pass measured the opposite on the running game — the presenter awaits HudPort.chooseCommand and the FFX-2 engine is ticked only in its waiting branch, so the gauges stand still during command input with the coach layer on OR off (?coach=off behaves identically). Bailey named the property “FFX-2 lines come from Rikku with nothing paused”, which is about the line, and the line is measurably non-blocking; the badge now claims only that. Whether the X-2 clock should run during command input at all is an Active-vs-Wait question for the combat core (§4.2 row “Command input”: Active mode time runs, Wait mode time freezes on entering a submenu) and needs Bailey’s yes — see docs/handoff/onboarding-c.md “Open”.

tiles.label: A: Taught first turn (not chosen)
tiles.note: A short cold open, then three coach marks on the real HUD, one at a time. Good work, simply not the one picked on 20 Sep 2026 — kept so the sheet stays readable and nobody re-proposes it as new.

tiles.label: B: Field notes (not chosen)
tiles.note: No interruption at all: one line on the hint bar and a HOW TO PLAY page on demand. Not picked on 20 Sep 2026; kept for the record, not rejected art.
